challenges.instruction: Here is a net of squares. If you fold it up along its edges, does it make a cube? Choose Valid net or Invalid net, then press Check.
challenges.hint: Fold the squares up one at a time around one square. Does each square land on its own face?
challenges.narration: Will this net fold into a cube?
challenges.netExplanation: Every square folds onto a different face, so the six squares close up into a cube.

challenges.instruction: Here is a net of squares. If you fold it up along its edges, does it make a cube? Choose Valid net or Invalid net, then press Check.
challenges.hint: Fold the squares up one at a time around one square. Does each square land on its own face?
challenges.narration: Will this net fold into a cube?
challenges.netExplanation: Two squares fold onto the same face of the cube, so one face is left open.
